follow-up time: From first trimester of pregnancy until delivery
outcome: Levels of phthalate metabolites in amniotic fluid
Neonatal anthropometric measures (weight, height, head circumference, chest circumference, hip circumference, arm circumference)
cohort: 142 pregnant women in Isfahan, Iran, who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: There was no statistically significant association between phthalate metabolites concentration in amniotic fluid and newborn's anthropometric measures.
